text:
**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and there's a pad for AirPods on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It includes a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty. WIRED lists it at $98, or about $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. I don't have a direct product link, so the buy links are in WIRED's guide: [WIRED's best 3-in-1 chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Other picks by need:**

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | Qi2 25W; no power adapter included, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25) |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station | about $40 on Amazon | 15W, Qi2-certified, includes a charger and cable; the Apple Watch puck detaches |
| Flat, out of sight overnight | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Qi2 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow |
| Travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | about $80 | Folds flat, 15W, 2-year warranty |
| Travel and desk | Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W | $130 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable, includes a 45W adapter |

- **Nomad, ESR, Nimble:** [WIRED's stand guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) has the buy links.
- **Anker and Satechi:** [WIRED's travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) has the buy links. Macworld also [reviewed the Satechi](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html).

**Does 25W matter?** Only for the iPhone 16 and 17 series, and some models only get 20W. For example, one retailer page says the ESR CryoBoost gives full 25W only on the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. WIRED says the faster speed makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin is enough for most people.

If you do want 25W in a folding stand, the ESR CryoBoost has a fan that can be switched off. It lists at $99.99 and is $82 with code PARTNER18 at [Dealectric's ESR page](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). That's an affiliate page, so Dealectric earns a commission. I haven't verified the code myself, and prices change, so check at checkout.

Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. Some older cases don't, and the AirPods pad won't work with them.
